summary.text: Rick Taggart is a Republican who represents District 55 (Mesa County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on January 9, 2023; Ballotpedia lists him as on the November 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Taggart earned a B.S. in business and environmental science from Syracuse University in 1972 and an M.B.A. from the University of Phoenix.
His career included work as an adjunct professor and executive director of marketing and recruitment at Colorado Mesa University, and as president and CEO of Victorinox Swiss Army, Ballotpedia says.
